headlines.text: That Saturday in 2022, Sammy Guevara vs. Dustin Rhodes etched their names into history in the first-ever AEW Interim TNT Title match, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.23. With Cody sidelined by COVID protocol, his brother Dustin stepped in for a gutsy performance ? a real Canadian Destroyer through a table nearly stole the interim title before Guevara escaped with a last-second pinfall reversal.
Turning the clock back to 2025: it was the first-ever encounter between Will Ospreay and Buddy Matthews, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 7.83 ? a good, competitive contest.
On this day in 2020, it was the first-ever encounter between Brotherhood and The Lucha Brothers on Dynamite, rated 6.62.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2025, when Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Adam Cole vs. Adam Page vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Jay White vs. Jeff Jarrett vs. Kyle O'Reilly vs. Lance Archer vs. Ricochet vs. Roderick Strong vs. Wheeler Yuta fought it out in a Casino Gauntlet match on Dynamite, rated 6.72.

Turning the clock back to 2022: Ricky Starks vs. Matt Sydal fought tooth and nail for the FTW Title, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 5.94. Matt Sydal was challenging for gold for the very first time.
Rewind to 2020, when Best Friends & Cassidy didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.78.
